description: A fast export branch skips the wrapper that guarantees an audit record.
requirements: Add a fast export path for fast requests. Every export must still record who exported which data.

expected.summary: The fast path calls exporter directly, bypassing the universal audited wrapper. Future export guarantees in the wrapper no longer cover every export.
Fast exports no longer record who exported which data. The sensitive export loses the audit trail that the normal path preserves.
